Vendored: sqlite3.c and sqlite3.h from the zip, unchanged (shell.c and
sqlite3ext.h are not vendored). Built with SQLITE_THREADSAFE=1,
SQLITE_OMIT_LOAD_EXTENSION and SQLITE_DQS=0 (engine/build.zig addSqlite).

HISTORY. Vendored at 3.49.1 (2025-02-18) with the Unicode data store
(0e3d0ffec) and never updated until 2026-09-29, when the stzlib-security
plane moved it to 3.53.4 (threat-model R15). The 3.50 line and later
carry security fixes. Compiled into stz_db, stz_seclog (the durable
security log), stz_unidata (it reads the pre-built unicode.db -- the same
answers on both versions, checked) and the SQLite fuzz harness.

UPDATING: take sqlite3.c and sqlite3.h from a newer amalgamation, check
its SHA3-256 against sqlite.org/download.html, rebuild, run
base/test/security/sql_bound_narrated.ring, durable_ledger_narrated.ring,
`zig build fuzz-sqlite`, and engine/tools/sbom.py.
